_about: Round 19 (2026-11-26): Anthony chose 'Cut the cost first, then go live' for the second close look and frame-exact timing (round 18 winner, about 37 cents of Claude extra per video). Measured first without sound: smaller pictures keep Opus's frame choice within a frame or two; Sonnet is looser; Haiku is unreliable on timing; lower thinking effort finds fewer actions for little saving.

variants.label: Cheaper: smaller pictures
variants.why: Same Claude model, but it gets smaller pictures and slightly fewer of them. About 22 cents extra per video instead of 37.

variants.label: Cheapest: smaller pictures and a lighter Claude model
variants.why: Smaller pictures, and the two looks are done by Claude Sonnet instead of Claude Opus. About 13 cents extra per video. In my measurements its frame choice was a little less exact.
